entities.summary: Akbar Yunis oghlu Suleymanov was an Azerbaijani writer, literary scholar, pedagogue, assistant professor (1956). He was the head of the Department of Azerbaijani Language and Literature of the Yerevan State Pedagogical Institute (1956–1980), head of the Azerbaijani branch of the Writers Union of the Armenian SSR (1964–1982).
